title: Implement Gated DeltaNet Linear Attention
prompt: Implement a recurrent gated DeltaNet core for one sequence. Decay the (Dk,Dv) state, then add beta*k outer (v-k@state); emit q@state at each step. Inputs provide already-normalized keys and scalar gates.

resources.title: DeltaNet Explained (Part I)
resources.why: Starts from linear attention as a matrix memory and derives the delta-rule update that corrects it.

resources.title: DeltaNet Explained (Part II)
resources.why: Continues with the chunked, parallel form of the delta-rule update.
